subject: POC timeline & milestones — Acme Industries
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC timeline & milestones — Acme Industries

Thanks again for your time today, Jordan — great discussion. As promised, attaching a concise POC plan that outlines timeline, success criteria, and proposed owners. High level summary below and a quick ask at the end.

Proposed 4-week POC (target start: week of July 6)
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): account setup, network/VPC checklist, SOC2 evidence exchange
- Week 1: ingest sample dataset + run baseline evals
- Week 2: iterate prompts/configs, run throughput/latency benchmarks
- Week 3: final readout + handoff recommendations

Success criteria (draft)
- Accuracy/quality: match or exceed current baseline on the NPS-style eval set (>85% pass rate)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms for 512-token requests in our dedicated profile
- Cost: projected per-1M-token cost < your current infra uplift by 30%

Owners
- Redwood: Marissa (PM) + Dev Patel (platform engineer)
- Acme: Jordan (POC lead) + Samantha (Data owner)

Asks: Can you confirm:
1) a preferred kickoff week (we suggested the week of July 6)
2) a 1-hour kickoff attendee list (engineering + security + PO)
3) any hard constraints on access (air-gapped environment / vendor approval timelines)

Attachment: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (3 pages)

Thanks — happy to discuss adjustments.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC timeline & milestones — Acme Industries

Marissa — thanks for the quick follow-up and the POC plan. This looks sensible. A few notes from our side: 

- Week of July 6 works for us for kickoff.
- Attendees (kickoff): myself (POC lead), Samantha (data), Michael Tan (infra lead), and I’ll loop in security depending on the pre-kickoff checklist
- Success criteria: the quality metric is fine but can we add an evaluation on hallucination rate for instruction prompts (target < 5%)?
- Procurement: I’ve added Procurement on cc — they’ll need your SOW and SOC2 summary to start internal approval.

Can Dev/Laura weigh in on the SOC2 evidence exchange and the network/VPC pre-reqs? We’re on a monthly release blackout from June 25–28, so anything that requires our infra time should avoid that window.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director of AI Product — Acme Industries
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC timeline & milestones — Acme Industries

Thanks Jordan — noted on the blackout window (we’ll avoid infra ops June 25–28). Quick technical checklist for pre-kickoff (we can run this as a short technical discovery call):

- Network/VPC: outbound HTTPS to api.redwood.ai on 443; optional private peering for Dedicated (if desired)
- Sample data: 10–50 representative examples (anonymized) + one evaluation set (acme-eval-criteria.xlsx)
- Auth: API key vs. mTLS — which do you prefer? For Private deployments we recommend KMS-backed keys
- SOC2 evidence: attaching a short summary (soc2-summary.pdf) — procurement will want the full report (we can provide a vendor-secured link)

If Jordan confirms kickoff week of July 6, I’ll block 60–90 minutes for the technical kickoff and set up a recurring 30-minute weekly check-in (Wednesdays) for status and blockers.

—
Dev Patel
Platform Lead, Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC timeline & milestones — Acme Industries

Perfect — thanks for the quick confirmations. Updated plan and next steps: 

1) Kickoff: Tuesday, July 7 at 10:00am PT (60–75m) — agenda: goals, data access, infra checklist, success criteria alignment
2) Pre-kickoff deliverables (by July 2):
   - Acme: share sample evaluation set + one representative dataset (anonymized)
   - Acme: confirm auth method (API key or mTLS) and provide who on your team will own access
   - Redwood: provide SOC2 evidence link and SOW draft
3) Weekly check-ins: Wednesdays, 30m, starting July 14 — quick status, blockers, action items
4) Final readout: Friday, Aug 7 — presentation of results, recommended production path, cost estimate

Attachments: updated POC plan + evaluation template (redwood-poc-plan.pdf; acme-eval-criteria.xlsx). Procurement — I’ll send the SOW (DocuSign link) by end of day.

If that works, Jordan please confirm attendees for the July 7 kickoff and we’ll send calendar invites.

Best,
Marissa
From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC timeline & milestones — Acme Industries

Thanks all — July 7 kickoff is good for us. Confirming attendees: Jordan, Samantha (data), Michael Tan (infra), Priya N. (security). We’ll deliver the anonymized dataset and evaluation sheet by July 2; procurement will review the SOC2 summary and SOW once Marissa sends the DocuSign link.

One more ask from security: can you confirm retention policies for cached requests and whether we support a delete-on-demand flow for keys/data used during the trial? If you can include that in the kickoff agenda that’d help speed approvals.

Thanks,
Samantha Cho
Data Science Manager — Acme Industries
